scope: Screened CFP same-key utility reproduced, unchanged-bit replay, fixed-key-schedule template-only linkage
caveats: Identity screening limitation retained from E01B.
Replay bypasses metadata/version checks; same-image and cross-image rates are separate.
K historical templates encode one source photo; query uses a different photo.
Operators and raw embeddings are unavailable to the linkage classifier.
Keys/pairs/directions/repeated splits are dependent; no significance claim.
Post-hoc direction-aware AUC uses test orientation and is diagnostic only.
No embedding reconstruction or camera attack evaluated.
